title: Formalizing Fefferman's Official Periodic Navier-Stokes Problem (B) in Lean 4: Global Linear Strain Exclusion on T3, Biot-Savart Direction Depletion Identities, and Conditional Reductions via Beale-Kato-Majda
description:
Single-Sentence Final Product Theorem (FeffermanClayNS.FinalProductTheorem.fefferman_periodic_ns_exact_reduction_product_theorem): For every viscosity ν ∈ R on the 3-torus T3 = R3/Z3, (Q1) spatial Z3-periodicity is equivalent to invariance under the three unit coordinate shifts f(x+ej) = f(x), and Fefferman's energy-bounded periodic statement implies his exact periodic statement (Clay_B_exact_with_energy(ν) → Clay_B_exact(ν)); (Q2) every Z3-periodic linear map L : R3 → R3 vanishes identically (L = 0), excluding any non-zero global linear Burgers background strain diag(−α/2, −α/2, α)x (α ≠ 0) on T3; (Q3) the Biot–Savart vortex-stretching determinant obeys det(ω(y), z, ω(x)) = det(ω(y)−ω(x), z, ω(x)) and vanishes under collinear alignment ω(y) = c ω(x), while under parabolic rescaling uλ(x,t) = λ u(λx, λ2t) both cubic stretching CCZ|ωλ|3 and viscous direction-curvature dissipation ν|ωλ|2|∇ξλ|2 scale homogeneously as λ6; (Q4) at a spatial maximum xmax where ⟨ω, (ω·∇)u⟩ ≤ CCZM3, ν⟨ω, Δω⟩ ≤ −νM2|∇ξ|2, and high-set direction-curvature coercivity |∇ξ(xmax)|2 ≥ cdirM holds, the maximum vorticity rate satisfies M'(t) ≤ CCZM(t)2 − (νcdir)M(t)3, which forces the uniform Lyapunov ceiling M(t) ≤ max(M(0), CCZ/(νcdir)); and (Q5) whenever a periodic flow class satisfies the high-set direction-curvature depletion hypothesis PeriodicDirectionDepletionBound(ν) and classical periodic Beale–Kato–Majda continuation PeriodicBKMContinuation(ν), Fefferman's periodic statement Clay_B_exact(ν) holds.

This standalone Lean 4 repository (leanprover/lean4:v4.30.0-rc1, Mathlib 4) contains 186 kernel-verified theorems across 6 modules with 0 sorry and 0 custom axioms (depending only on [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]), together with Ed25519-signed titan-audit and sealguard cryptographic certificates and the compiled monograph PDF.
